## Intent
Hypothesis: Halide-expressible branchless blend with per-particle hash RNG can approach the streaming ceiling by eliminating branchy respawn and keeping the death verdict in registers.

## Layout & approach
The AoS layout at 68 B/p offers 32 hot bytes (47%) for loop1 — age+pos+seed+vel — and 28 (41%) for loop2 — color+pos — leaving over half each line dead. No intermediate storage keeps the verdict in registers, but scalar codegen never exploits the contiguous fields for SIMD. Working set spills L1d at N≈481, L2 at N≈7710, L3 at N≈246723; with 47% hot bytes, effective traffic per useful particle exceeds the raw 68 B/p.

## Cache saturation
The ns/p curve is flat across regimes: ~34.5 ns/p in L1d (N=320-480), rising ~7% to ~37 ns/p at the L1d→L2 spill, then holding through L2/L3 and dipping to ~35 ns/p in DRAM (N≥250000). No sharp knee — the algo runs 6.4-7.7x above the 5.359 ns/p floor, so cache latency is invisible against frontend overhead. The dense grid resolves the L1d→L2 transition as a modest step; beyond it, regime is irrelevant.

## Bandwidth
Achieved 1.65-1.97 GB/s — 13-15% of the 12.69 GB/s ceiling, 6.4-7.7x above the floor. Profile: 55-60% frontend_stall, 40-45% compute, 0% backend/branch_flush at every N and q — frontend-bound, not bandwidth-bound. Death rate modestly degrades cost (34.5→41 ns/p, q=0.01→0.5) through extra scalar respawn work. Beats naive 1.2-1.6x (1.56x at q=0.01 N=320; 1.19x at q=0.5 N=10M) but trails the winner 2.2-5.3x everywhere (4.66x at q=0.01 N=320; 2.19x at q=0.5 N=10M). The gap narrows at high q but halide never closes it.

## Assembly
Entirely scalar despite the "halide-expressible" label. Halide's contribution is an external call (halide_b2) for setup; the hot per-particle loop (~192 insns/iter, stride 68B) uses vmulss, vaddss, vsubss — no packed SIMD on particle data. The 19 vector instructions are vmovaps for stack init and vmovss for constants. The loop carries 21 conditional branches, 12 cmovae selects for color clamping, and 16 byte-granular stores (mov BYTE PTR [r13+...]). vucomiss/vcvttss2si chains convert positions to pixel indices scalar-by-scalar. At 192 instructions the body exceeds the micro-op cache, forcing legacy decode — the 58-60% frontend_stall. The byte-granular scatter is structurally unvectorizable.

## Verdict
Refuted — the Halide-expressible formulation produced scalar codegen with no particle-level vectorization, running at 6.4-7.7x the memory floor and 13-15% of ceiling. It beats naive 1.2-1.6x (1.56x at q=0.01, N=320) because branchless blend and register-resident verdict still outperform scalar baseline, but is 2.2-5.3x slower than the autovec winner everywhere (4.66x at q=0.01, N=320; 2.19x at q=0.5, N=10M). The mechanism is frontend starvation: 192 insns/iter with 21 branches overwhelms decode (58-60% frontend_stall), and byte-granular scatter stores cap bandwidth at ~1.9 GB/s regardless of regime or death rate.
